model.shape: M512 natural routing, K3072, dual N1024

k256_lds_partial.description: 64-column by 64-row body; decode one complete K256 slab once, retain F32 partials in LDS between slabs

k32_register_accumulator_followup.description: 64-column by 64-row body; retain 32 F32 accumulators per lane and double-buffer only one K32 weight tile

protocol.timing: nine counter-rotated HIP-event samples, two warmups, burst three; pack inclusive
protocol.trace_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/laguna-gate-k256-ldsacc-nounroll-rocprof.cDijCp -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 512 --layer 1 --modes t16-mmq64x64-d8-f32-k256-ldsacc --warmups 0 --samples 1 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build

decision.reason: The K256 body collapses occupancy under 39.9 KiB LDS and 248 VGPR while repeatedly spilling the tile partials through LDS. Keeping all partials in registers removes the slab traffic but remains 66.5% slower because the 64-row schedule expands padded work and doubles column workgroups.
